{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Stew|Stew]]

'''Chicken mull''' is a type of chicken stew made with milk.

==Ingredients==
*Whole [[Cookbook:chicken|chicken]] or equivalent amount of chicken parts as desired
*½ [[Cookbook:gallon|gallon]] (about 2 liters) [[Cookbook:milk|whole milk]]
*1 can (12 oz / 350 ml) [[Cookbook:evaporated milk|evaporated milk]]
*1 stick (½ cup / 110 g) of [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
*1–2 cans (14–28 oz / 430–860 ml) [[Cookbook:Chicken Broth|chicken broth]] (if using boneless, skinless chicken parts)
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*Ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Saltine Cracker|Saltines]]
*[[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|Hot sauce]]

==Procedure==
#In a large pot, [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] chicken or parts until completely cooked.
#Turn heat to medium, then remove chicken from water and allow to cool.
#Remove chicken from bone if using whole chicken or bone-in parts.
#Using a meat grinder, grind the cooked chicken. Alternatively, cut into small pieces.
#Add chicken back to chicken stock. If using skinless chicken parts, add chicken broth.
#Add butter, evaporated milk, and enough milk to fill the pot. Season with salt and pepper to taste, and stir well.
#Serve in bowls, adding hot sauce as desired, with crumbled saltines mixed in.
